verdict.rationale: Pipedream provides extensive docs with code snippets (e.g., docs-4, docs-12) and a hosted chat app (chat.pipedream.com) to try MCP tools interactively (docs-9), plus per-app tool/API references (docs-19, docs-20), which together approximate an interactive reference experience. However, there is no explicit evidence of a dedicated 'API reference' UI with embedded runnable/live examples akin to a Swagger/Postman-style explorer. Missing for 10: a documented interactive API explorer with inline runnable code, and independent user confirmation of using it as a reference tool.
